decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake spraying system extends the firm's core spraying and plural-component know-how, so its own R&D and harsh-condition coating expertise let it interpret field results and refine the system rather than abandon it after one year.

The low-pressure injection pump sits very close to the established injection and construction repair business and has its own web page, so the firm can readily absorb customer feedback and improve it.
The material transfer pump draws directly on decades of pump and conveying engineering, so the firm can assimilate early results and adapt it, even though it is only mentioned on the website.

Fire protection flow monitoring builds on the firm's fluid-control knowledge and supports its digitalization goals, and its own web page plus R&D cooperation with research institutes give the firm the capacity to develop it further.
